verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers n8n's visual/code building, AI agent nodes, MCP support, and integrations, but contains no documentation of a natural-language-to-workflow generation or editing feature (e.g., an 'AI workflow builder' or prompt-based canvas editing). n8n-docs-26 only describes a workflow that converts natural language into API calls as a use case, not n8n generating/editing the workflow itself from a prompt.
